verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Stripe surfaces dispute-rate calculations and fraud/volume trend visualizations on the Radar dashboard (dispute measurement, fraud-insights charts) plus a review queue for workload tracking, but there is no evidence of a false-positive-rate metric, an approval-rate-lift metric, or a board-ready export/reporting feature. missing for 10: false-positive rate metric, approval-rate lift metric, explicit data export/reporting for finance/board consumption.
